description: DECIMER (normal model) SMILES from v1 for three crops that v2's DecimerSegmenter produced from tests/fixtures/pdfs/synth_015.pdf (index = position in the segmenter output; it equals the top-to-bottom order, which is the slot order of judges/load/data/fixtures/synth_015.json). Recorded once from the local v1 copy (marcus-judge-backend, never production); the test suite never calls v1.
crops_command: docker run --rm --network none -v $PWD/tests/fixtures/ocsr/make_crops.py:/w/make_crops.py:ro -v OUT:/out marcus-v2-tf-test:local python /w/make_crops.py /app/tests/fixtures/pdfs/synth_015.pdf /out  (tests/fixtures/ocsr/make_crops.py: renders each page with marcus.workers.pdfsafe.render_page_png, segments with marcus.workers.segment.DecimerSegmenter, saves each crop as RGB PNG exactly as segment._write_crop does; 15 crops, 3 kept)
